narrative: What started as a simple high school dare turned into the greatest love story of our lives. We became boyfriend and girlfriend for a week just for fun, never expecting that one playful challenge would change everything. After our first breakup, fate seemed to have other plans for us. A few months later, we made another promise — to stay together until we met the love of our lives. Somewhere along the way, we realized we already had. On November 27, 2011, Jade officially asked me to be his girlfriend, and since then, we've grown up side by side through every season of life. From high school sweethearts to forever partners, our story has always been built on love, laughter, friendship, and choosing each other every single day. Now, after all these years, we can't wait to begin our next chapter together as husband and wife.
content:
What started as a simple high school dare turned into the greatest love story of our lives. We became "boyfriend and girlfriend for a week" just for fun, never expecting that one playful challenge would change everything.

After our first "breakup," fate seemed to have other plans for us. A few months later, we made another promise — to stay together until we met the love of our lives. Somewhere along the way, we realized we already had.

On November 27, 2011, Jade officially asked me to be his girlfriend, and since then, we've grown up side by side through every season of life. From high school sweethearts to forever partners, our story has always been built on love, laughter, friendship, and choosing each other every single day.

Now, after all these years, we can't wait to begin our next chapter together as husband and wife.
